title: SettingsUpdatedPayload

unit.description: What an idle span is counted in: days, weeks (seven days) or months (calendar months, a month-end clamped to the shorter month's last day).

anyOf.description: A span of quiet: 1 to 1000 days, weeks or calendar months.

sessions.autoSettleAfterIdle.description: How long a session is quiet before auto-settle settles it (settledBy auto-idle); null never settles a session for being idle.

sessions.autoSettleOnMerge.description: Whether auto-settle settles a session one of whose pull requests merged at or after its anchor, the latest of its last activity, its unsettling and the end of its last snooze (settledBy auto-merge).

sessions.transcriptCompactAfterDays.description: How many whole days a session goes with no run, command or event before its transcript events are folded into a snapshot that replaces them for replay; 1 to 3650. Organisation events are never compacted.

anyOf.description: An account's id on its environment: a version 4 UUID the environment mints when it adopts or adds the account; an account carried over from configuration keeps the id it was configured with.

accounts.defaultAccount.description: The account a session with none of its own runs on (ADR 0018); null, or an account the environment no longer holds, for the first account adopted or added that it still holds.

accounts.defaultModelFamily.description: The model family (opus, sonnet) whose strongest model a run takes when neither it nor its session names a model; null, or a family the account does not offer, for the account's strongest model. The Account step presets it to the highest tier's family.

accounts.defaultEffort.description: The reasoning effort a run with none of its own takes, when its model takes that effort; null, or an effort the model does not take, for the model's own. The Account step presets it to high.

accounts.favouriteModels.description: The model ids the account and model picker offers first, in the order the person put them, each once, at most 20; empty for the provider's recommended models. A model the selected account does not list is passed over.

providers.processIdleMinutes.description: How many minutes a provider process may be idle with no held work, or parked on a prompt, before it stops: 1 to 1440; preset 30.

permissions.defaultCeiling.description: The ceiling a pairing gives when none is chosen.

permissions.unattended.mode.description: The mode of every unattended run that names none (a routine or bot without an override, a completions request without a mode): acceptEdits or bypassPermissions.

anyOf.description: An instant as an ISO 8601 UTC timestamp.

permissions.unattended.bypassAcknowledge.description: When bypassPermissions was first acknowledged as the unattended mode; null until it has been. Recorded by the environment, never set directly.

unit.description: What a duration is counted in: minutes, hours or days.

anyOf.description: A duration: 1 to 1000 minutes, hours or days.
A parked prompt waits until it is answered; a denylist prompt a Claude run waits on is closed, and its call denied, after 24.8 days, the longest its tool hook can wait.

permissions.parkedPrompt.ttl.description: How long a parked prompt waits before it is denied and its run continues: a duration, or never.

permissions.containment.default.description: The containment level of a run whose session names none.

updates.autoUpdate.description: Whether the environment updates itself to its channel's newest release; preset on. While a version is pinned, auto-update is off.

updates.channel.description: Which releases the environment follows: stable (the newest release without a prerelease part) or beta (the newest of all, prereleases included); a pinned version follows neither.

anyOf.description: A release's version: a semantic version without the tag's v (0.4.2, 1.0.0-beta.2); one with a prerelease part is a prerelease, which only the beta channel follows.

updates.pinnedVersion.description: An exact version to run on any channel, without the tag's v, or null for none. While one is set auto-update is off; clearing it returns to the auto-update switch.

updates.idleWindowMinutes.description: The idle window, in minutes: the environment is idle once no run has started or ended within it, and a run parked on a prompt counts as busy for it only; 1 to 120, preset 10.

updates.deferralCapHours.description: The deferral cap, in hours: how long busy work may hold a pending update before the environment drains for it anyway; 1 to 168, preset 24, with no never.

name.description: A theme's name: 1 to 40 characters counted as code points, on one line, with no control or format character and no white space at either end.

hue.description: The OKLCH hue in degrees, from 0 up to but not including 360.

canvas.description: The neutral base: the window's ground and every surface, hairline and edge drawn from it.

hue.description: The OKLCH hue in degrees, from 0 up to but not including 360.

accent.description: The accent: fills, focus rings, selection and links; the one colour that means act.

The OKLCH hue in degrees, from 0 up to but not including 360.

warning.description: The warning status, and what waits on the person.

hue.description: The OKLCH hue in degrees, from 0 up to but not including 360.

danger.description: The danger status: errors and denials.

appearance.theme.description: A theme: a name and seven seeds (canvas, accent, machine, thinking, success, warning, danger), each an OKLCH hue and chroma. Every colour a client paints is a token derived from them, in a light and a dark ladder; a theme file is this shape as JSON.

items.description: A host name, IPv4 address or IPv6 literal, with an optional leading wildcard label (*.example.com): no scheme, port or path.

browser.devSites.description: browser.devSites: the hosts being developed, as host patterns (localhost, *.myapp.test), where a Chrome's cookie values, storage and evaluate are allowed; loopback, private, link-local, CGNAT and unique-local addresses and .local, .internal and .lan names count without being listed, a cloud metadata address never. Preset empty.

browser.evaluateEverywhere.description: browser.evaluateEverywhere: a Chrome runs evaluate on every site, not only dev sites. Preset off.

browser.deepReadEverywhere.description: browser.deepReadEverywhere: a Chrome reads cookie values and storage on every site, not only dev sites. Preset off.

propertyNames.description: An account's id on its environment: a version 4 UUID the environment mints when it adopts or adds the account; an account carried over from configuration keeps the id it was configured with.

anyOf.description: No Chrome until one is chosen in the session: the preset.

environmentId.description: The environment the Chrome is paired with.

anyOf.description: A paired Chrome's id: a UUID its environment mints when it pairs.

chromeId.description: The Chrome; null for the plain My Chrome, whichever of that environment's Chromes is connected.

anyOf.description: This Chrome for every new session of the account.

additionalProperties.description: An account's reach: per-session, or a Chrome always.

browser.reach.description: browser.reach: by account id, whether a new session of the account starts with a Chrome: per-session (no Chrome until one is chosen), or a Chrome of an environment always. An account not listed is per-session; preset empty.

browser.headless.allowRuns.description: browser.headless.allowRuns: whether runs on this environment may drive its headless browser. Preset on.

browser.headless.endpoint.description: browser.headless.endpoint: an operator's browser beside the environment, by its CDP address (http, https, ws or wss); null for none, when the environment launches a Chromium itself. Preset null.

browser.headless.executable.description: browser.headless.executable: the Chromium or Chrome the environment launches when no endpoint is set; null to look in the platform's usual install locations and PATH. Preset null.

maxContexts.description: The most live browser contexts, one per session; a session past them is refused with a sentence; 1 to 16, preset 2.

idleMinutes.description: Minutes with no tool call before a session's context is closed; 1 to 1440, preset 10.

tabHeapMb.description: Megabytes of heap past which a tab is closed, least recently used first; 1 to 16384, preset 500.

exitMinutes.description: Minutes with no context before the browser is asked to exit; 1 to 1440, preset 5.

browser.headless.limits.description: browser.headless.limits: the headless browser's tab rules, none of which can be switched off.

items.description: A host name, IPv4 address or IPv6 literal, with an optional leading wildcard label (*.example.com): no scheme, port or path.

browser.internalHosts.description: browser.internalHosts: the internal hosts, as host patterns, that the headless browser and web_read may reach; loopback, private, link-local, CGNAT and unique-local addresses and .local, .internal and .lan names are refused unless listed, and cloud metadata addresses always. Preset localhost, 127.0.0.1 and ::1.

credentials.injection.description: credentials.injection: whether runs on this environment receive credentials (the forge variables and credential helper, and the key managers' block), unless an account's entry or a routine's own injection says otherwise. Preset allow.

propertyNames.description: An account's id on its environment: a version 4 UUID the environment mints when it adopts or adds the account; an account carried over from configuration keeps the id it was configured with.

additionalProperties.description: Whether runs receive credentials (the forge variables and credential helper, and the key managers' block): allow or deny.

credentials.injectionByAccount.description: credentials.injectionByAccount: by account id, allow or deny, which outranks credentials.injection for that account's runs and terminals and is outranked by a routine's own injection. An account not listed takes the environment's value; an account's entry is dropped when the account is removed. Preset empty.

network.bindTailnet.description: Whether the environment binds its Tailscale address beside loopback from its next start, when one is found; preset on, so a machine with a tailnet address is reachable on it. With no address found it binds none either way.

anyOf.description: An IPv4 or IPv6 address an environment binds or could bind: never the wildcard address (0.0.0.0, ::, or the IPv4-mapped ::ffff:0.0.0.0).

network.bindLan.description: The LAN address the environment binds beside loopback from its next start, or null for none (off, the preset). It must be an address the machine holds, one environment.status lists as a LAN address it could bind; a start that finds the machine does not hold it binds loopback and the tailnet without it, saying so on standard error, and the Your machines step needs attention naming it. Anyone on that network could try to reach the environment; it still needs a paired client.

instructions.orientation.description: Whether every run is handed the orientation block, first in its standing instructions; off, the block is left out of the next run's text.

values.description: The keys that changed, with their new values.

description: settings.updated: settings changed; the keys that did, with their new values.
